entries.title: Glyph (in Luma): Experimental Lettering in Luma | thecreatingco

meta_description: Loop is a focused ScenePilot tool for turning a clip into a short video loop. Use it when you have one moment to repeat, rather than a full film to arrange.

entries.title: Reframe: Adapt Wide Video for Vertical Viewing | thecreatingco
meta_description: Reframe is the ScenePilot tool for adapting a wide video to a vertical frame. A tighter frame changes what the viewer can see, so review the composition throughout the clip.

entries.title: Sessions: Shared Listening Rooms in The Circle | thecreatingco

meta_description: Pocket Studio is The Circle’s local audio recorder for voice memos, melodies and sounds. It is distinct from Sattari Pocket, the beat sketchpad.
